verdict.rationale: The evidence documents act, extract and validate commands (skyvern-docs-19), human-in-the-loop approval pauses between steps (skyvern-docs-10), and after-the-fact artifacts showing the AI's reasoning (skyvern-docs-11). None of these is a primitive that lists candidate actions on the current page before the agent commits to acting. Approval pauses and post-run reasoning logs are adjacent features, not an observe/plan preview, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can preview candidate actions on the current page (observe/plan) before committing the agent to act
